# Tabler Icons

Vendored outline SVGs from https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons at commit `74929e50416e2b7c0abb8368cdc74bdcb2560ab6`.

MIT license; see LICENSE. Icons use a 24px grid and 2px currentColor stroke.
Only icons used by the interface and its design vocabulary are included.

`jersey.svg` derives from `shirt-sport.svg` with its decorative number removed,
so a player portrait fallback does not imply an unrecorded jersey number.
